"Great, I appreciate it," Jo says, handing you a clean dish towel before stepping into the back corner with the café phone. 

For the next few minutes, you hear Jo's quiet voice confirming a bean delivery and checking off invoice numbers. No new customers come in while you watch the front, leaving the counter quiet except for the hum of the espresso machine.

Soon, Jo hangs up the receiver and returns to the counter. "All sorted with the supplier. That's the counter covered—just the cups left to clean, and then those 10 Coins are yours." 

A tray of used ceramic mugs and saucers sits beside the sink, ready to be washed.
